description: A utility class for evaluating concept reference ranges within the OpenMRS system. It includes methods to evaluate criteria expressions, retrieve the latest observations for concepts and persons, compare observation dates, and perform date calculations relevant to medical concept reference ranges.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceRangeUtility
classes.description: A utility class for evaluating concept ranges and related date computations in the OpenMRS medical record system.

methods.name: evaluateCriteria
methods.description: Evaluates a criteria expression against an observation object using Velocity template engine, returning true or false.

methods.name: getLatestObs
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent observation for a given concept reference and person.

methods.name: getCurrentHour
methods.description: Returns the current hour of the day in 24-hour format.

methods.name: getCurrentObs
methods.description: Returns the current observation if it contains a valid value; otherwise, fetches the latest observation.

methods.name: getLatestObsDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the latest observation for a given concept reference and person.

methods.name: isObsValueCodedAnswer
methods.description: Checks if the latest observation's coded value matches a given concept reference.

methods.name: getObsDays
methods.description: Calculates the number of days since the latest observation for a concept.

methods.name: getObsWeeks
methods.description: Calculates the number of weeks since the latest observation for a concept.

methods.name: getObsMonths
methods.description: Calculates the number of months since the latest observation for a concept.

methods.name: getObsYears
methods.description: Calculates the number of years since the latest observation for a concept.

methods.name: getDaysBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two dates.

methods.name: getWeeksBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of weeks between two dates.

methods.name: getMonthsBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of months between two dates.

methods.name: getYearsBetween
methods.description: Calculates the number of years between two dates.

methods.name: getDays
methods.description: Calculates days from a given date to the current date.

methods.name: getWeeks
methods.description: Calculates weeks from a given date to the current date.

methods.name: getMonths
methods.description: Calculates months from a given date to the current date.

methods.name: getYears
methods.description: Calculates years from a given date to the current date.
